description: Flow paths as Sankey. Pick dimension (incl. SrcAS→DstAS after ./deploy.sh --asn), filter exporter/protocol/port/CIDR. Top N (default 8) controls node count; Detail rows for the table below.

panels.description: Top N nodes per side; remainder rolled into Other. Use filters above to focus a slice of traffic.

targets.query:
WITH
    flows AS
    (
        SELECT
            ipToStr(sampler_address, etype) AS exporter,
            ipToStr(src_addr, etype) AS src_ip,
            ipToStr(dst_addr, etype) AS dst_ip,
            ifNull(nullIf(dictGetString('dictionaries.protocols', 'name', toUInt64(proto)), ''), concat('proto-', toString(proto))) AS protocol,
            concat(
                ifNull(nullIf(dictGetString('dictionaries.protocols', 'name', toUInt64(proto)), ''), toString(proto)),
                '/',
                toString(dst_port)
            ) AS dst_service,
            if(src_as = 0, 'AS0', concat('AS', toString(src_as))) AS src_asn,
            if(dst_as = 0, 'AS0', concat('AS', toString(dst_as))) AS dst_asn,
            bytes * if(sampling_rate = 0, 1, sampling_rate) AS traffic
        FROM $table
        WHERE $timeFilter
          AND (${exporter:singlequote} = 'All' OR ipToStr(sampler_address, etype) = ${exporter:singlequote})
          AND (${protocol:singlequote} = 'All' OR ifNull(nullIf(dictGetString('dictionaries.protocols', 'name', toUInt64(proto)), ''), concat('proto-', toString(proto))) = ${protocol:singlequote})
          AND (${dst_port:singlequote} = 'All' OR toString(dst_port) = ${dst_port:singlequote})
          AND (
                ${src_net:singlequote} = ''
             OR (
                    etype = 2048
                AND isIPAddressInRange(
                        ipToStr(src_addr, etype),
                        ${src_net:singlequote}
                    )
                )
          )
          AND (
                ${dst_net:singlequote} = ''
             OR (
                    etype = 2048
                AND isIPAddressInRange(
                        ipToStr(dst_addr, etype),
                        ${dst_net:singlequote}
                    )
                )
          )
    ),
    labeled AS
    (
        SELECT
            multiIf(
                ${dimension:singlequote} = 'exp_dst', exporter,
                ${dimension:singlequote} = 'src_port', src_ip,
                ${dimension:singlequote} = 'proto_port', protocol,
                ${dimension:singlequote} = 'exp_src', exporter,
                ${dimension:singlequote} = 'src_as_dst', src_asn,
                src_ip
            ) AS src_node,
            multiIf(
                ${dimension:singlequote} = 'exp_dst', dst_ip,
                ${dimension:singlequote} = 'src_port', dst_service,
                ${dimension:singlequote} = 'proto_port', dst_service,
                ${dimension:singlequote} = 'exp_src', src_ip,
                ${dimension:singlequote} = 'src_as_dst', dst_asn,
                dst_ip
            ) AS dst_node,
            traffic
        FROM flows
    ),
    top_src AS
    (
        SELECT src_node
        FROM labeled
        GROUP BY src_node
        ORDER BY sum(traffic) DESC
        LIMIT toUInt64OrZero(${topn:singlequote})
    ),
    top_dst AS
    (
        SELECT dst_node
        FROM labeled
        GROUP BY dst_node
        ORDER BY sum(traffic) DESC
        LIMIT toUInt64OrZero(${topn:singlequote})
    )
SELECT
    if(src_node IN (SELECT src_node FROM top_src), src_node, 'Other') AS source,
    if(dst_node IN (SELECT dst_node FROM top_dst), dst_node, 'Other') AS destination,
    sum(traffic) AS traffic
FROM labeled
GROUP BY source, destination
HAVING traffic > 0
ORDER BY traffic DESC
LIMIT 300

targets.query:
SELECT
    ipToStr(sampler_address, etype) AS exporter,
    ipToStr(src_addr, etype) AS source,
    ipToStr(dst_addr, etype) AS destination,
    ifNull(nullIf(dictGetString('dictionaries.protocols', 'name', toUInt64(proto)), ''), toString(proto)) AS protocol,
    dst_port,
    src_as,
    dst_as,
    sum(bytes * if(sampling_rate = 0, 1, sampling_rate)) AS traffic,
    count() AS flows
FROM $table
WHERE $timeFilter
  AND (${exporter:singlequote} = 'All' OR ipToStr(sampler_address, etype) = ${exporter:singlequote})
  AND (${protocol:singlequote} = 'All' OR ifNull(nullIf(dictGetString('dictionaries.protocols', 'name', toUInt64(proto)), ''), concat('proto-', toString(proto))) = ${protocol:singlequote})
  AND (${dst_port:singlequote} = 'All' OR toString(dst_port) = ${dst_port:singlequote})
  AND (
        ${src_net:singlequote} = ''
     OR (etype = 2048 AND isIPAddressInRange(
            ipToStr(src_addr, etype), ${src_net:singlequote}))
  )
  AND (
        ${dst_net:singlequote} = ''
     OR (etype = 2048 AND isIPAddressInRange(
            ipToStr(dst_addr, etype), ${dst_net:singlequote}))
  )
GROUP BY exporter, source, destination, protocol, dst_port, src_as, dst_as
ORDER BY traffic DESC
LIMIT toUInt64OrZero(${detail_rows:singlequote})
